import {fireEvent, screen} from '@testing-library/dom'
import {test} from 'vitest'

const composing = true
const options = {key: 'Enter', isComposing: true}

test('composes', () => {
  fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter'})
  fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter', isComposing: false})
  fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter', isComposing: composing})
  fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {...options})
  fireEvent['keyDown'](screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter', isComposing: true})
  fireEvent.keyUp(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter', isComposing: true})
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('textbox'))
  const fire = fireEvent
  fire.keyDown(screen.getByRole('textbox'), {key: 'Enter', isComposing: true})
})
